notes: All statements ran serially inside read-only transactions with rollback; PostgreSQL and client timestamps were parsed as UTC.
Historical request counts and current catalog/pool/replay observations are distinct snapshots.

Replays retain deployed retrieval CTEs with equivalent contract predicates and replace response projection with aggregate counts. Audio-prefilter variants add the same exact-audio eligibility predicate before the neighbor limit. Chinese variant changes display lookup only.
Candidate counts precede application canonical deduplication, ranking, final eligibility and issuance. These are not full service or load/performance acceptance tests.
No viewer/session identifiers, credentials or embedding vectors exported. Seed IDs identify public catalog videos.
No production data, configuration, application source or deployment changed.
